basic_details.short_information: BEML Limited has released the BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026 short notification for 44 ITI Trainee posts in the Fitter and Electrician trades. The recruitment has been announced under Advertisement No. KP/S/20/2026, dated 13 November 2026. BEML, a Schedule 'A' Government of India undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, is looking for candidates with experience in the Rail and Metro domain for its business operations.

Open the Careers section of the website.
Look for Advertisement No. KP/S/20/2026 for ITI Trainee (Fitter and Electrician) posts.
Download and read the detailed recruitment notification once it is available.
Check the educational qualification, experience, age limit and other eligibility conditions.
Open the official application link when BEML activates it.
Complete the registration process as instructed on the recruitment portal.
Fill in the required personal, educational and experience details.
Upload the prescribed documents, photograph and signature, if required.
Pay the applicable application fee, if any.
Review the completed application form and submit it before the announced deadline.
Download or print the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEML Limited has announced a total of 44 ITI Trainee vacancies, including 17 posts for ITI Trainee (Fitter) and 27 posts for ITI Trainee (Electrician).

faq.question: Q2. What is the notification release date for BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026 short notification was released on 13 November 2026 under Advertisement No. KP/S/20/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply has not yet been announced in the short notification. BEML will publish the application schedule on its official Careers page along with the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates interested in the Fitter and Electrician posts should have the relevant trade qualifications prescribed by BEML. The exact ITI qualification, minimum marks and certification requirements will be confirmed in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can visit the official BEML website at bemlindia.in and open the Careers section. The detailed advertisement and application instructions for Advertisement No. KP/S/20/2026 will be published there. Candidates should check their eligibility and follow the official instructions once the application process opens.
